Pinazepam (rINN) Pinazépam; Pinazepamum. 7-Chloro-1,3-dihydro-5-phenyl-1- (prop-2-ynyl)-2H-1,4-benzodiazepin-2-one. Пиназепам C18H13ClN2O = 308.8. CAS — 52463-83-9. ATC — N05BA14. ATC Vet — QN05BA14. Profile Pinazepam is a long-acting benzodiazepine with general proper- ties similar to those of diazepam (p.986). It is given in oral doses of 5 to 20 mg daily in divided doses for the short-term treatment of anxiety disorders (p.952). Doses of 2.5 to 5 mg at night have been used in the treatment of insomnia (p.957). Preparations Proprietary Preparations (details are given in Part 3) Hong Kong: Domar; Ital.: Domar; Mex.: Yunir; Singapore: Domar; Spain: Duna; Thai.: Domar.
